package project2;

public class Ass_09_10_2026 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		/*
		 * Q1. Count Even and Odd Numbers Write a Java program to count how many even
		 * and odd numbers are present in an integer array. Input: {11, 24, 35, 42, 56,
		 * 67, 80, 93} Expected Output: Even numbers: 4 Odd numbers: 4
		 */
		int a[]= {11, 24, 35, 42, 56, 67, 80, 93};
		int even=0;
		int odd=0;
		for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)
		{
			if(a[i]%2==0)
				even++;
			else
				odd++;
		}
		System.out.println("Even numbers="+even);
		System.out.println("Odd numbers="+odd);
		
		/*
		 * Q2. Find Duplicate Elements Write a Java program to identify and print all
		 * duplicate elements in an array. Each duplicate element should be printed only
		 * once. Input:{10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 10, 50, 30, 60} Expected Output:Duplicate
		 * elements: 10 20 30
		 */
		
		int aa[]= {10, 20, 30, 20, 40, 10, 50, 30, 60};
		int duplicate[]=new int [aa.length];
		
		System.out.print("Duplicate elements: ");
		for(int i=0;i<aa.length;i++)
		{
			for(int j=i+1;j<aa.length;j++)
			{
				if(aa[i]==aa[j])
				{
					duplicate[i]=aa[i];	
					System.out.print(duplicate[i]+" ");
				}
				
			}
			
			

		}
		
	}

}
